name: youtube-seo
description: Turns a product demo, tutorial, or audit recording into 2 YouTube title options, a Key Moments description with `00:00` chapters phrased as searchable sub-steps, a matching X and LinkedIn launch post, and a `VideoObject` JSON-LD embed on the matching blog post, all written to the user's repo. Use when the user uploads or links a video, asks for YouTube titles, descriptions, chapters, or timestamps, wants a video to rank on Google or show in AI Overviews, or wants to embed a video on a blog post for SEO.

findings.excerpt: │   └── Run `npx scribiz <url-or-file>` (or ask for the .srt from YouTube Studio > Subtitles > Download)
